telemetry_address.description: Address on which to expose metrics.

telemetry_endpoint.description: Path under which to expose metrics.

interface.description: Interface to search for Homeplug devices.

destaddr.description: Destination MAC address for Homeplug devices.

log_level.description: Only log messages with the given severity or above. Valid levels: [debug, info, warn, error, fatal]

log_format.description: Set the log target and format. Example: "logger:syslog?appname=bob&local=7" or "logger:stdout?json=true"
